messages:
alex: Heads-up 1 launch-post + webinar SEO handoff. Need final owners for: redirect patter nization, canonical rules, JSON-LD snippets, internal anchor map, and cross-post CTAs. Who can take which? :spiral_calendar:
jess: I can do the JSON-LD drafts (event, videoObject, faq). Will include hasPart chapters and uploadDate. Target Tue AM. Any constraints on structured fields?
tom: Ill own redirects and 404 pattern remediation. I will pull the 90-day 404s and propose top-40 redirects. Prefer 301 for permanent moved content.
katie: Ill take canonical & meta robots rules + rel=canonical examples. Will add guidance: strip UTM, prefer canonical to root product/launch page, and canonicalize tag pages to main hub when duplicates exist.
sam: Ill handle internal linking + CTA anchors. Will produce an anchor map CSV and suggested anchor text variations for A/B. Also check that CTA IDs are stable across releases.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: redirect-rule-test at 2026-06-12T04:00Z -> staging (canary 10%).
jess: Schema notes: include "isAccessibleForFree": true for recording, set "interactionStatistic" for registrations (type: InteractionCounter), and attach "identifier" for transcript chapters. Also include organizer.name + url.
tom: Redirect example Im planning to propose (patterns.csv entry):
```
/from-old-launch/(.*),/webinars/2026-inference/$1,301
/blog/legacy-announce, /blog/2026-launch,301
```
Will also flag redirects that need change in GA filters.
katie: Canonical snippet for blog posts:
```
<link rel="canonical" href="https://www.redwood.com/blog/2026-launch" />
<meta name="robots" content="index,follow" />
<!-- strip querystring and UTM with server-side middleware -->
```
Add note: use x-robots-tag for PDFs.
sam: Internal anchor plan: primary CTA = "Watch the demo" -> /webinars/2026-inference#cta-demo. Fallback selectors: `[data-cta="watch-demo"]`, `#watch-demo` in case markup changes. Will include suggested anchor text list and priority weights.
jess: Also include FAQ markup outline. Example:
```
{
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {"@type": "Question","name": "How to access the recording?","acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer","text": "Link to registration page and on-demand"}}
  ]
}
```
(Will expand with 6 Qs).
tom: Staged rollout plan: 1) deploy 10% via LB rule for 24h, watch 200/301 ratios and error rate; 2) increase to 50% for 6h; 3) full. Ops will keep a rollback ready. Ill attach patterns.csv and nginx sample lines.
katie: Add SEO check step post-rollout: fetch canonical headers, run site: query for duplicates, check sitemap entries.
alex: Good. Timeline recap: JSON-LD + FAQs = jess by Tue AM; redirects patterns.csv = tom by Tue EOD; canonical guidance = katie Wed AM; anchor map + CTA list = sam Fri EOD; rollout plan docs = tom + ops Thurs. If blockers ping #eng-frontend or DM. :thumbsup:
